name: e-Shram Card
full_name: e-Shram Portal - National Database of Unorganized Workers
benefit: ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, access to government scheme benefits, UAN number for tracking
benefit_hindi: ₹2 lakh ka durghatna bima, sarkari yojana ka labh, UAN number

eligibility.description: Unorganized workers aged 16-59 years who are not members of EPFO/ESIC
eligibility.description_hindi: 16-59 saal ke asangathit kshetra ke mazdoor jo EPFO/ESIC mein nahi hain
criteria: Unorganized worker (construction, domestic, agriculture, street vendor, gig worker etc.)
Not a member of EPFO or ESIC

steps: Visit eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC center
Enter Aadhaar number and verify with OTP
Download e-Shram card with UAN number
steps_hindi: eshram.gov.in ya nearest CSC center jaayein
Aadhaar number daalein aur OTP se verify karein
Apni jaankari, pata, aur kaam ki details bharein
e-Shram card UAN number ke saath download karein

hindi_summary: e-Shram Card se asangathit kshetra ke mazdooron ko 2 lakh rupaye ka durghatna bima milta hai. Aadhaar card se online register karein ya CSC center jaayein. Helpline 14434 par call karein.
